Overview

Roam is a free premium-quality travel 3D icon set featuring 60 stunning, modern, and high-resolution icons designed to instantly elevate your website, mobile app, or marketing materials. Each icon is stylishly crafted with unique compositions, vibrant colors, and professional 3D rendering — perfect for illustrating anything related to Travel, Tours, Guides, Experiences, Bookings, and Promotions.

Whether you’re designing a travel website, building a booking app, or creating social media campaigns, Roam icons set will help you save time, maintain a consistent design style, and capture attention with eye-catching visuals.

About the product

This maps and navigation icon set turns wayfinding into toy design — a fat teardrop pin, a two-tone paper plane, a bridge built from thick rounded beams, each shape rendered like a piece from a matte-and-gloss desk toy set rather than a flat glyph.

The collection runs through the full navigation vocabulary: pins, compasses, GPS arrows, road signs, vehicles, and landmarks, all catching the same soft studio light and holding one consistent pastel palette across the set.
